svg.text: Figure 1: exp3 Epidemiological Calibration — Generation Intervals, Cohort R0/Re, and Importation Alignment
5-state EpiHiper digital twins (GA, MA, MN, VA, WA; cell 0.25, replicate 0, tickZero = 2020-11-30). Comparing exp1, exp2, and exp3.
Dashed blue: Hart et al. (2022) Alpha = 5.5 d
Dashed purple: Hart et al. (2022) Delta = 4.7 d
B. exp3 Cohort Reproduction Numbers (R0 & Re)
Dots = 5 states; bars = 5-state mean (E1 Alpha in blue, E2 Delta in purple)
Malthusian growth rate r = ln(Re)/GI held invariant: exp1 r = 0.109/d vs. exp3 r = 0.100/d
C. E2 (Delta) Importation Schedule vs. Wave Peak
Pre-peak E2 seeds restored: 36-89 seeds (exp2) -> 307-749 seeds (exp3, 4.3x-11.7x more)
